A Quick Guide to Choosing Bedroom Wall Lights

Your bedroom is a haven of recharging, relaxation, and reorientation that you can eagerly look forward to every single night. Types of Modern Bedroom Wall Lights

title: Bedside Lamps Lights
description:
Bedside Lamps – Everything You Need to Know

A Little History

For more than a century now, we’ve been decorating our bedrooms with colorful and beautiful bedside lamps to shed a shimmer. 

When we say bedside lamp, the most common design that comes into our minds is the traditional bedside lamp which has a base, often shaped like a pot or a vase, and a steel bar through it which holds the bulb and the shade. It looks like a mini tree.

Designs influenced by nature were  common practice at the end of the 19th century and the beginning of the 20th. There were a lot of reforms that were taking place and arts & sciences were affected drastically.

Around 1911, in a bid to move away from the Victorian-era styled designs, Dirk van Erp became one of the first people to invent the bedside lamp design that we adore and love even today. 

Though there are multiple variations today, the main elements of this design are constantly retained. Thus, making this design the most versatile.

Not only are bedside lamps a source of light but they are mainly an integral part of the overall design. A small lamp has the power to profoundly affect the overall look and feel of your bedroom. 

That’s the only reason why bedside lamps come in so many shapes, sizes, and designs.

Different Types of Bedside Lamps

There are literally hundreds of designs available in the market today. It can be a daunting task when searching and planning to buy one, be it online or offline. 

To make the process easier, we have broadly categorized the lights into eight categories based on their various design attributes and how they can suit your bedroom. This should help you with the decision-making process. 

Traditional Lamps

When we talk about traditional bedside lamps, we refer to the modern version of the antique lamp we mentioned above. The most well-known bedside lamps are the ones with a fabric shade material and a solid base.

These lamps look classy and they perfectly serve their purpose of providing necessary illumination in the bedroom. You can even use its light for reading your favorite book without feeling disturbed or you can use it to have a thoughtful conversation with your partner.

Obviously, most traditional styled lamps come with the ability to reduce or increase brightness.If you are looking for a classy and traditional style for your bedroom, these bedside lamps are perfect.

Metal Lamps

Bedside lamps made with metal frames or metal elements such as steel, bronze, etc., tend to look more rugged in nature and can be used to give your bedroom a rusty yet classy look.

While there are different types of metal lamps that can be used based on an occasion, most of them are used to make a bold statement or bring boldness into the room.

So if you are looking for any of these attributes as part of your overall bedroom design, you can use metal lamps.

Modern Lamps

Modern bedside lamps are technologically advanced and they have totally different designs. Breaking the barrier would be an appropriate statement to attribute to their designs.

Most modern designs have abstract designs with intrinsically embedded bulbs which give a contemporary look. They attract many millennial and Gen Z crowds that want to have a minimalist design and save space, yet serve the purpose.

So, if you want to have a modern and contemporary setup in your home and bedroom, then modern bedside lamps would be a perfect addition to your space. 

Wooden Lamps

Wood and warmth have always gone hand-in-hand. Wooden designs give the house a warm look and make you feel you are home. It applies to bedside lamps as well.

The wooden lamps come in multiple varieties. The most common ones have a strong wooden base with either soft or bright colors which set the tone. You also get a mix of a wooden base and a shade made out of leaves or pinewood. This mixture is often used in Oorjaa lights as we want to give our lights a natural feel.

If you want your bedroom to feel natural, homely, and soft, adding wooden bedside lamps will make a big difference.


Hand Crafted Lamps

This is our specialty at Oorjaa. Hand-crafted lamps create a beautiful vibe and they are often intriguing. They are made with multiple elements such as  cement, banana fibre, lokta fibre etc.

They come in different styles and fashions. So, it gives you more leverage on what to choose from, based on the style statement or the mood you want to set for your bedroom or hallway or even your living room at night.

If you are artistic and want to give your room an artistic feel, hand-crafted bedside lamps are the best.  They also last longer because they are made from organic materials which are sustainable.

Antique Lamps

As the name suggests, if you want to add antique elements to your space then antique lamp designs will do the job.

Most antique lamps follow a certain concept. Maybe replicating some societal elements from a previous era. Generally, they tend to look classy in nature and they suit only specific setups.

If you have a home which has a more classical or traditional look with antique furniture and settings, then these lamps will undoubtedly add significant value to your space.

Children’s Lamps

Children’s bedside lamps can have a great effect on your child’s cognitive processes. They are fun and it helps them  smile before they sleep every day.

In both cases, boys and girls always look at these lamps before they sleep and dream big. That’s definitely the best way to improve your thought processes.

So, make a wise choice when it comes to buying a bedside lamp for your children.

Different Colors & Materials

Now that we have broadly classified the various types of bedside lamps you can choose from, the next question that might require an answer is “what color and material should I consider?”

To begin with, the color is totally dependent on the color of your room. For example,If you have a room with a solid tone and you want your light to blend in perfectly, you have to buy a lamp with dark or solid tones. 

Likewise, if you want a better contrast in your current setting, you would need a brighter color to create a different vibe. So, the choice of color predominantly lies on what vibe you want to set in your room.

When it comes to material, each material conveys a different message and sheds a different light. The seven types mentioned above also include the materials.

At Oorjaa, we mainly use natural materials like fiber paper made out of banana leaves, fiber weaves, concrete, and cement to create the shades. We use pine wood, steel, and stone to create the base and foundation. As mentioned earlier, all designs are handcrafted.

Together they create a natural look and add an exotic feel to your bedroom. 

At the end of the day, it all depends on the design of your room and what elements you want to add to the room to make it look better. If you can answer that question, then choosing the right bedside lamp would not be a problem at all.

You may want to check or consult with an interior designer if you are unable to quickly make a decision.

Bedside Lamps Online

When making an interior design choice, we often suggest visiting a store to experience a product before you make a purchase. Unfortunately, the pandemic has rendered us to stay at home until things get normal again.

Hence buying lamps online is the best way to go ahead. 


In Conclusion

Whether you want to improve your room’s design with the help of a bedside lamp or you just want some dim light that can get you to sleep, regardless of your need, these lamps are a necessary addition.

If you want to improve your design you may have to spend a little more time and money to make the perfect choice. You have to consider multiple elements that are discussed here to make a final decision.

We wish you all the best as you select the bedside lamp that suits your needs.

LED Lamps – A Quick Guide To Choose The Right One For Your Home

When you hear words like modern, sleek, next-gen, or smart lamp, you can only think of an LED lamp. They have all the right attributes to make it a winner among all the other lamps. 

LED stands for Light Emitting Diode. Unlike incandescent lamps bulbs or filaments, which heat up due to resistance against electricity and generate light, a diode in a LED lamp exchanges charged electrons from one side of the lamp to the other side (or the side which needs charged electrons) to generate the light. 

Due to this fluid and advanced process of generating light, LED lights produce very minimal heat and in most cases no heat at all. This is clearly not the case with incandescent bulbs or lamps because they generate a lot of heat.

LED bulbs and LED lamps on the other hand rarely get damaged and they’re long lasting. They also use eco-friendly substances which are not hazardous and therefore will not contaminate the planet when they are disposed. 

They are energy efficient and they can fit into any design too.

These attributes of LED lamps or lights make them ideal for most lighting appliances in your home.

Different Types of LED Lights

There are three types of LED lights – bulbs, tube lights, and panel lights.

LED bulbs are the most commonly used LED lights that fit most household purposes. They can be used in table lamps, wall lamps, bedside lamps, floor lamps, and much more.

LED tube lights, as the name suggests, are tube lights which can replace the traditional fluorescent tube lights that are often used. They last very long when compared and they also generate very less heat. More importantly, one light is often sufficient to light up an entire room, which is not the case with fluorescent tube lights as they require more than one if they have to light up a larger room.

LED Panel lights have the ability to fit into any size and shape. While the name suggests that these lights are best suited for panels, they are not limited to it. All the smart designs that we come across in the LED section make use of these lights. 

Based on these lights, LED lamps are created. Generally, a lamp design is created with a certain type of light in mind. For example, a table lamp may use an LED bulb, whereas a wall lamp may use tube lights. Likewise, if you have a design to light up the ceiling, then you would need panel lights.

LED lights also come in different shapes and sizes to fit even the smallest lamp.

Different Colors to Choose From

LED lamps can offer three colors. They are Daylight, Cool White, and Warm White. 

They are categorized based on their intensity. 

Daylight LEDs are the most intense LEDs and they emit a bluish-white light. They are best suited for commercial settings and office spaces. Daylights are a little more power consuming when compared to other LED colors.

Cool White LEDs have a bright white color and they suit workplaces, homes, and places which require a brighter and focused light.

Warm White lights have a slightly yellowish white color. Most of the LEDs we use in our homes are warm white LEDs.

Which LED Lamp Should You Choose?

The color and type of LED you choose are totally dependent on the design of your holder. If you are looking at a specific purpose such as decorative lights or reading lights, then there are LED lights that are already present to serve that very purpose.

It is also important to choose the right LED based on the size of your room. 

These are some factors that you should consider when buying a LED lamp.

Night Lamp – What exactly is it?

-        Task lights – Task lights are your reading lights or table lamps. Many task lights are also used as night lamps.

-        Accent lights – These are the lights that light up only a specific region. You will find them in art museums or on walls or while walking in part. Most night lamps are formulated as accent lights because they light a certain area of the room instead of the entire room. They spread just enough light around them to remove darkness.

So, generally, night lamps are used either as a task light or as an accent light. It is very rarely used as a general light. We strongly recommend that you don’t use it as a general light as it will not serve the purpose and might end up being a huge disaster.

Adjustable LED Bulbs/Lights

Fluorescent or Incandescent bulbs

When you purchase a night lamp, the provider of that night lamp will give the bulb along with the lamp. However, if they are not giving a bulb along with it, they will most certainly provide the specification of what bulb suits that lamp. You can then buy the bulbs with less power & brightness or more power & brightness, depending on your need.

A Quick Buyer’s Guide on Wall Mounted Lights

Delightful layering of lights across your home requires a thoughtful mixture of various types of lighting lamps and fixtures. In spaces where only hanging and ceiling lights alone cannot suffice the design requirement, stylish wall mounted lights will provide the much required boost of both illumination and flair. Wall mounted lights are indeed a timeless fashion of lighting fixtures that can enhance existing lighting and design elements in every room of your home.

These lights never go out of style, and have been the central attraction of homes for centuries! Before the invention of electricity, wall mounted lamps and candle holders were critical for keeping rooms well lit and to get everyday work done. In fact, these antique and traditional lamps played a great role in influencing the modern wall light designs and many popular choices are still fashioned around these old yet golden lights. 

If the vintage look isn’t really your style then you can choose among the many simple minimalist wall lights as well as the modern and contemporary ones, that do come in a wide range of appealing styles and finishes. This wide spectrum of choice helps interior designers and home decor experts & lovers to maintain or innovate a cutting edge lighting design, while still retaining many classical and antique elements.

At Oorjaa, we embed multiple styles to bring about some truly inspiring wall mounted lights that have enlightened the homes of many. While you check out our designs, we do recommend that you follow this quick guide on how to select your ideal

How to Choose A Wall Mounted Light

To find the best wall mounted light for your home and space, in line with the style you desire, you should consider how these three design elements interact and what kind of statement you want to make.

Light Shades - They surround the light source or the lamp and direct the light. Shades come in various materials such as metal, wood, fabric, glass and more. And the materials do affect the light emitted. Each element has its own style and way of dispersing light.

The Mount - The mount or in most cases the backplates act as the fixture to the wall upon which the light is mounted through a connecting … (sentence is incomplete) . The color and material of the mount play a great role in creating the overall style and statement of your wall mount light.

The Connecting Arms - The arms connect the mount and the light source, thereby completing your wall mounted light. While most connecting arms are plain, they may at times have some subtle designs to improve the overall look and feel of the light.

In most modern and contemporary lights, the connecting arms are quite dynamic and movable, which can greatly impact the design as well as serve a multi-purpose role.

It is important to remember that these three aspects of a wall mount are critical when you are deciding the design. You have to ensure that you find a light that matches your aesthetic and add cohesion to your home.

You also get uniquely shaped designs that are custom created by designers to generate a certain look and feel. If you are into designer lights, then you should consider some interesting designs based on the purpose of your light.

Check For Additional Features Before Finalizing Your Wall Mounted Light

As you search and finalize the wall mounted light that fits your style, you’ll also want to check the technical details of your potential fixture to make sure that it will be easy for you to install and use.

It’s also important to identify what you want your wall mounted light to accomplish before you finalize your purchase. You should consider technical details such as the installation type. Do you want it with a cord and plug or with an on/off switch? Do you want it to have modern technology embedded into it, such as automatic dimming and lighting with voice commands?
